codes.refused: the pack, its weights or the device cannot serve the request (signature, structure, arch, fit, limits, broken variant); the message names the reason
codes.oom: device memory: the open or a step does not fit; the message carries the fit numbers
codes.unsupported_parameter: a request parameter the task does not define, or one this pack does not declare in io.params
codes.invalid_parameter: a declared parameter with a value outside its schema (type, range, enum)
codes.no_contract: a numerics request the pack has no measured contract for
